# The Urban Bakery

> Boutique bakery, café, and event catering in Noga Square, Tel Aviv–Yafo.

The Urban Bakery (אורבן בייקרי) is a bakery and café located at Nitzana 14, Noga Square, Tel Aviv–Yafo, Israel.

## Facts
- Address: 14 Nitzana St, Noga Square, Tel Aviv–Yafo, Israel
- Phone: +972-55-775-6454
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 07:00–19:00, Friday–Saturday 07:00–16:00
- Website: https://urbanbakery.co

## Services
- Café: fresh pastries, sourdough breads, and coffee, served on-site.
- Catering: hosting trays ("mgashei eiruach") for office meetings, happy hours, corporate events, and wedding preparations.
- B2B wholesale: fresh-baked pastries, breads, cakes, and cookies delivered daily to other businesses, including Fridays and Saturdays.
